lessons_used: Post-adoption and post-certificate sign-in reordering, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt, while other sync hints showed no clear effect.
Path selection clarity headlines, spotlight layouts, and visual redesigns worked; checklist layouts hurt, while copy simplifications, value refreshes, and time banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints worked; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and activity displays showed no clear effect.
Companion previews paired with quality guides or split upload layouts worked; compact grids, photo fallback flows, guidelines banners, and mascot stamp redesigns hurt results.

Interactive spawn placement flows and system tray location tips worked; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt results, while mascot greetings and docking hints showed no clear effect.

Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive major wins (e.g., interactive spawn placement flow, visual redesigns) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., mascot stamp redesign, direct controls guide).

lessons_next: Post-adoption/certificate sign-in reordering, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners worked; post-waiting sign-in hurt, while other sign-in reorders and sync hints showed no clear effect.

Path selection clarity headlines, spotlight layouts, and certain visual redesigns worked; checklist layouts and story scroll narrative redesigns hurt, while copy simplifications, value refreshes, and time banners showed no clear effect.

Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints worked; 3D trackers, completion timers, sound notifications, and background activity displays showed no clear effect.

Companion previews paired with quality guides or split upload layouts worked; compact grids, photo fallback flows, guidelines banners, and mascot stamp redesigns hurt, while pre-adoption review flows, ownership guarantees, and layout customization showed no clear effect.

Interactive spawn placement flows and system tray location tips worked; direct controls guides and first interaction tips hurt, while mascot greetings, docking hints, retrieval callouts, and welcome stage redesigns showed no clear effect.

Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive wins (e.g., interactive spawn placement flow, visual redesigns) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (e.g., mascot stamp redesign, direct controls guide, story scroll redesign).
